page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a KVM-based GPU accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz with 4 physical cores and 8 virtual CPUs using 2 threads per core. The system provides 60.0 GB of dedicated system memory, translating to 7.5 GB per physical core, backed by a 40 MB L3 cache. Graphics acceleration is powered by a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. Hardware provisions also include 472 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

In synthetic compute benchmarks, the Intel Broadwell-generation CPU exhibits moderate execution capability. Single-core CPU tests place in the bottom 10%, while multi-core stress testing and uncached memory bandwidth fall into the bottom 25%. However, the PassMark CPU score falls within the average range. The integrated NVIDIA P100 GPU achieves strong prompt processing speeds for small 135M and medium 7B model LLM inference workloads, placing in the top 10% for prompt ingestion throughput and the top 25% for 7B text generation. Legacy CPU limitations affect cryptography and database operations, which measure in the bottom 25%.

The combination of an NVIDIA P100 GPU and 472 GB of integrated local SSD storage delivers GPU execution without requiring additional block storage attachments. While CPU-bound tasks are constrained by the older host processor, the high RAM allocation and GPU offload capacity provide qualitative efficiency for GPU-bound execution models. This instance fits workloads such as small to medium LLM prompt processing, deep learning model evaluation, static web serving, and parallel CUDA execution tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated KVM virtual machine configured with an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 CPU offering 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores at 2.5 GHz, paired with 60.0 GB of RAM. The instance includes a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM, 472 GB of bundled local SSD storage, and 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations highlight weak single-core and multi-core CPU capabilities alongside weak memory read bandwidth due to its older CPU platform. Conversely, the integrated NVIDIA P100 GPU demonstrates strong prompt processing speeds for small and medium LLM inference tasks, reaching top 10% performance for 135M and 7B model prompt ingestion. The combination of local SSD storage, 60 GB RAM, and GPU acceleration provides a resource footprint suitable for deep learning model inference, CUDA batch processing, and GPU-assisted web infrastructure.
